title: CNA Now: Simba faces possible licence suspension, plus other news as it happens
snippet: Stay on top of the day's biggest stories with CNA Now, which brings you breaking news and major developments from Singapore and around the world.

title: PGA Tour not planning return program for ex-LIV players, CEO says
Taking leave, buying PS5s and getting their partners' approval: How Singapore gamers are preparing for GTA 6
snippet: After a 13-year wait, Rockstar Games' Grand Theft Auto VI (GTA 6) launches on Thursday (Nov 19). From taking unpaid leave to buying new gaming setups, Singapore fans share how they're preparing for the big day.

title: Simba does not contest unauthorised spectrum use, other licence breaches; director set to resign
snippet: Simba has informed Singapore's regulatory authorities of the circumstances surrounding the unauthorised use of the spectrum bands and the remediation steps to prevent recurrence.

title: New Zealand all-rounder Santner ruled out of India tests with broken hand
United Airlines says technology outage that delayed departures has been resolved
JPMorgan says software bug slows its transactions
California consumer watchdog chief says AI companies that violate state rules will be taken to court
Singapore assessing impact of new US chip export controls aimed at curbing China’s access
snippet: Under the new US restrictions, a licence will be required to export, re-export, or transfer (in-country) advanced semiconductors to Indonesia, Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand, or Brazil.

title: Wirtz scores twice as Germany thrash Dutch 5-0 to win Nations League group
No amount of laws or policing can prevent unrest without good governance: Shanmugam
snippet: Speaking in an interview with CNA, Senior Minister K Shanmugam said protests are not the only way to be heard and that many avenues are available.

title: Commentary: Why readiness matters now for Singapore’s nuclear energy question
snippet: With limited domestic energy resources, retaining that ability to choose whether to deploy nuclear energy is itself an important part of energy security for Singapore, says Dr Victor Nian from the Centre for Strategic Energy and Resources.

title: Trump-Xi talks, first Putin trilateral put spotlight on diplomacy at China’s APEC summit
snippet: China hosts APEC for the first time in 12 years. High-profile sideline diplomacy is drawing attention amid questions over whether the forum in Shenzhen can deliver more than symbolism.

title: As Jakarta prepares for another flood season, hope and scepticism abound
snippet: As much of Indonesia enters the rainy season in November, some Greater Jakarta residents wonder if new infrastructure can cope with a major disaster. Others are relying on community efforts in the face of authorities’ constraints.

title: Commentary: Microsoft outage shows that big tech can’t be treated as too big to fail
snippet: Centralisation, consolidation and unchecked monopolies have left our digital lives, our businesses and our governments in an incredibly precarious place, says this academic.

title: The Porsche Macan GTS goes electric, but keeps its sporting ambitions
snippet: From its powerful dual-motor setup to its track-focused technology, the electric Macan GTS brings a performance-first approach to Porsche’s compact SUV.

title: Wall Street ends sharply lower on AI jitters ahead of Nvidia results, Anthropic IPO
Lindsay Clancy to face March retrial in deaths of her 3 children
snippet: Her lawyers claim she suffered from postpartum psychosis, while prosecutors argue that she planned the killings and knew what she was doing.

title: Top doubles player Patten criticises ATP chairman, CEO for absence from trophy presentation
Trump says 'would not mind' Huang being reinstated at Nvidia
snippet: The US president said “I would certainly not mind seeing that,” expressing support for Jensen Huang's possible return as Nvidia chief.
